# CodexMeter 2.0.12
Fixed the notch occasionally staying open in **Show on hover** mode.
Clicking the notch's curved margin or tooltip used to pin it silently. A quick click on the folded notch could do the same if the cursor monitor opened it before the click arrived. Plain clicks now keep hover behavior, so moving away folds the notch again. To hold it open, right-click and choose **Keep open**, or select **Always show** in Settings.
## Verification
- 662 automated tests completed with 9 environment-specific skips and no failures. - Regression coverage uses the native notch panel and cursor polling on all four edges, including tooltip clicks, rapid re-entry, and explicit pinning.
## Installation
- macOS 14 or later; Universal 2 for Apple Silicon and Intel. - Ad-hoc signed. Sparkle updates use Ed25519 signatures. - No database or account migration.
Homebrew users can update with:
```bash brew update brew upgrade --cask --greedy dlfkdLR/tap/codexmeter ```
